summary: Frontend-only visual redesign verification for LightStudy. All 4 public pages (/, /login, /register, /about) and all 11 authenticated student pages plus /app/admin render successfully with the new theme: ivory background rgb(248,245,238) = #F8F5EE, Playfair Display serif on headings, gold active nav pill rgb(201,162,39) = #C9A227, dark navy sidebar and text. New book+star SVG logo is used in the header/sidebar (no wizard image as logo). Fili wizard is used only as the AI avatar on Landing and Dashboard. Landing shows the tagline 'УЧИСЬ ОСОЗНАННО · ДОСТИГАЙ БОЛЬШЕГО'. Student and admin logins work. Admin panel tabs (Дашборд, Пользователи, Предметы, Программа, База знаний, Задания, Статистика) render with the new theme. AI tutor (Фили) sends and receives responses. Part 2 lists tasks. No render regressions attributable to the redesign.

minor.issue: Returns 500 for the student account -> Student /app/statistics page content area is empty. Out of scope (backend), but visible to user.
Returns 500 -> /app/subjects page shows heading only with no subject cards; /app/practice subject dropdown empty; /app/part2 subject filter also affected. Out of scope.
Axios 500 leaves an Uncaught runtime error React dev-overlay on /app/profile, /app/practice, /app/part2 in dev mode. Underlying page still renders below the overlay. Not caused by the redesign.

issues: Bar chart 'Уровень по предметам' still uses old purple bar for Математика and red bar for Обществознание. Chart series colors were not migrated to the new gold/navy palette. Likely hardcoded chart colors in the Statistics component.

action_items: Update chart series colors on admin/statistics 'Уровень по предметам' bar chart to use the new gold/navy palette (currently still purple/red).

Add try/catch or error boundaries around axios calls on Profile, Practice, Part2, Statistics and Subjects pages so that a 500 response does not surface an 'Uncaught runtime errors' React dev overlay (student sees blank/broken UI in dev). This will also handle the current student-account 500s from /api/statistics and /api/subjects gracefully.
critical_code_review_comments: Redesign successfully applied across index.css tokens, common.jsx Logo/LogoMark SVG, and AppLayout sidebar; all pages consume the new tokens.

Axios error handling is missing in several student pages: unhandled promise rejections propagate to React error overlay. Wrap requests with try/catch and render an inline error/empty state instead of throwing.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for redesign; all pages render with new theme, no blank pages, functional flows work

test_credentials: Student: student@lightstudy.ru / student123, Admin: admin@lightstudy.ru / admin123 (both verified working).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Visual redesign task passed. If retesting, note that /api/statistics and /api/subjects return 500 for the student seeded account; that is a backend/data problem, not a redesign regression. Look at admin Statistics bar chart to confirm chart colors have been updated.
rca of the issue: Redesign - no bugs to RCA. Bar-chart color leftover is likely a hardcoded array in a recharts/chartjs config rather than pulling from CSS tokens. Profile/Practice/Part2/Statistics/Subjects dev-overlay errors are caused by axios rejections from pre-existing 500 responses on data endpoints for the student seed user, propagating uncaught.
